title: Minimum Operations to Obtain All Vowels
statement:
You are given a string `s` consisting only of lowercase English letters. In one operation you may choose any index `i` (0‑indexed) and replace `s[i]` with the next letter in the alphabet; the letter `'z'` wraps around to `'a'`. You may apply the operation any number of times on any indices.

Your goal is to make the final string contain **at least one** occurrence of each of the five vowels `'a'`, `'e'`, `'i'`, `'o'`, `'u'`. Return the minimum total number of operations required. If it is impossible (which can only happen when the string length is smaller than 5) return `-1`.
summary: Compute the minimum number of letter‑increment operations needed to ensure the string contains all five vowels at least once.

examples.explanation: The string already contains every vowel.
Convert the five `'z'` characters to `'a'`, `'e'`, `'i'`, `'o'`, `'u'` respectively. Costs: 1, 5, 9, 15, 21 → total 51.
One optimal assignment is: keep `'a'` (0), keep `'e'` (0), change `'b'`→`'i'` (7), `'c'`→`'o'` (12), `'d'`→`'u'` (17). Total = 36.
